title: Accept companion-only dataTypes when capability advertised
description:
Spec sync to jmap-chat-spec 63e9d08 (diff 0cd3af0..63e9d08). Oracle: the quoted spec text at 63e9d08.

[wss] Accept companion-only dataTypes when capability advertised
Spec (): draft-atwood-jmap-chat-wss-00.md L175: "It also defines two companion values: `"vtc"` ... recognized only when the server advertises `urn:jmap:vtc:websocket`, and `"scene"` ... recognized only when the server advertises `urn:jmap:scene:websocket`." L194: "If `dataTypes` is empty, or contains only unrecognized values (i.e., none of `"typing"`, `"presence"`, or a companion value whose capability the server advertises), the server MUST respond with a `RequestError` ..."
Code: crate-jmap-chat-server/src/ephemeral.rs:83-95; crate-jmap-chat-server/src/ephemeral.rs:61-65; crate-jmap-chat-types/src/vocabulary.rs:76-85; crate-jmap-chat-types/src/ephemeral.rs:16-25; crate-jmap-chat-vtc-server/src/lib.rs:298-307; crate-jmap-chat-scene-server/src/lib.rs:23-31
Now: EphemeralSubscription::from_enable only knows typing/presence and returns invalidArguments when neither is present, so ["vtc"] or ["scene"] alone is rejected. The chat-vtc/chat-scene binding docs say to set chat_vtc/chat_scene only from a frame that replace_with accepted, so a companion-only subscription can never be turned on. The vocabulary.rs doc says companion values "do not count as recognized", which the spec no longer says.
Change: from_enable/replace_with must take the set of advertised companion capabilities (or a vtc/scene flag pair), record vtc/scene in EphemeralSubscription (with accessors), and return an error only when nothing recognized is left. Update the vocabulary.rs and ephemeral.rs docs and the binding-crate docs to match. Changing from_enable/replace_with is a public API change.
